title: spec: the localSignIn jsdoc says "It changes no server door", but the provider delete (#33623) and the auth settings save (PR #33781) now answer by it — say "no sign-in door"
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jVPGBoi3MCGoKbW1Hv

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding N1 from the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER record 6894038792 on PR #33781 (#33358), restated in the delta record 6894124120 and review 6894135404. Grading and lane are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

- 规范里说本地登录开关"不改变任何服务端入口",现在已不准确:删除最后一个身份提供方、保存认证设置这两个入口都会按它判断。
- 只改两处规范注释的措辞("不改变任何登录入口"),不改行为。

## What

The spec says of `localSignIn`: "It changes no server door: password sign-in answers the same either way". That is at `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts` ~L295-299 and `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts` ~L399-405 on main. The sign-in doors are indeed unchanged. Two other doors now answer by it: the provider delete (since #33623) and the auth settings save (PR #33781). The sentence should say "no sign-in door" and name those two.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue "changes no server door"` finds 0.
